structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUBDW 10-18): the KV die hub element qkd_ahub_static_dw (static six-root hub) as a cluster of 5 CLOSED children (4 ot_nhb_zh m5 views, ot_qkh_recip_leaf np1 view) + flat core / io logic; the closed qkd_ahub_core belongs to the legacy hub and is not used.  RTL pin rules in 02f980add (flop-first pins, ot_rst_pipe regional resets). || KV-AHUBDW2 10-18 (a1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP -412 ps, classified: core logic depth + cross-cluster wire, NOT child insertion -- macro class +178 ps, spine leaf spread 29 ps): (1) u_io export decided one edge ahead (em_q from latched tgt_q; was cal_r_q -> PV_START+R adder -> compare -> 145 W-face enables, 289 endpoints); (2) qkd_ahub_static_core_la: every calendar decode registered one edge ahead (u_dn) with an edge-age-1 decode for the first cycle (u_d1), nblk(T) registered from the held command T (u_io T_p/T_h) (age -> rz/rc_x/zh_p/zh_iv/ma_x, T -> hh_b/k_b/z_b); (3) zh_err registered at the Z tree outputs (child zerr -> fault -273 ps); (4) am valid without the u_io.start term (start -> E-face am flops -109 ps; a start on an am edge now faults). || HKV-AHUB4 10-19 (a4): hardened at the KV DIE binding Z_IN_STRIDE = 4 (kv_static_die ASTK_Z_STRIDE = the CLOSED qkd_astk_ctl_s Z stride; claude/hkv-die-1019 e070e47a2 binds ONLY this parameter, AP_OFS / FR_OFS stay RTL defaults). The a3 kit (qkd_ahub_sdw-a3-dad8bea8e) is the RTL default stride 16 = a reference, NOT the die binding. RTL byte-identical to a3 (04e81f626): at stride 4 the Z window divide / modulo are 2-bit shifts / masks (the guard Z_IN_STRIDE < 4 passes; slot_h = d[1:0], slot_k = d[5:2], k <= 15 since nblk <= 16). || HKV-AHUB5 10-19 (a5): hardened at the KV die's FULL binding (HKV-DIE2 decision, HKV-DIE3 593596f40 OT_KV_AHUB_OFS: the die binds the ACTUAL post-station AP_OFS / FR_OFS, kv_static_params AHUB_OFS_BOUND checks kit == die == table): Z_IN_STRIDE 4 + AP_OFS [WS,WN,ES,EN] = [-36,-36,-34,-35] (64'hffddffdeffdcffdc = {16'hffdd, 16'hffde, 16'hffdc, 16'hffdc}) + FR_OFS -7 (32'hfffffff9: yosys chparam cannot decode '-7', 32'h two's complement verified on yosys 0.68 = -7 for the integer parameter), from the kvs14p-fa7fe4ff9 netlist table (results/rtl/qwen_kv_die/hkv_die2_1019/static_params_fa7fe4ff9_netlist_vs_90dedf84f_model.json: D(ks_ahs) 46, D(ks_pvfst) 40, D(ap) 8/8/10/9). AP_OFS / FR_OFS are constant addends of the u_io calendar adds (cal_n = c + AP_OFS, tgt_n = PV_START + R + FR_OFS): the netlist changes, the geometry does not.  a4 (default offsets {4{2}} / 0) is NOT die-bindable (bench m8 FAILS against the die).  The die relay table moves with every KV re-place: a different table needs a5' (or runtime offsets) -- AHUB_OFS_BOUND fails closed.  reset_landing opt-out: the RTL lands rst_n (ot_rst_pipe s0/s1). || KV-AHUB6 10-19 (a5 74c87116c NEEDS_RTL TT -357.42 / FF -38.17, classified at TT: NOT offset arithmetic (the offsets are constant addends, u_io paths met); two WIRE classes across the cluster: (1) u_core.q_rh[0] -> 32 rc_x -357 ps = 2 AO21 + ~650 ps of buffered wire, the 2-bit recip head reached a 4:1 root mux spread between the four Z trees -> q_rs, a registered one-hot select (one keep flop per tree, same D source/edge) and rc_x = AND-OR of the four roots; (2) u_recip/y -> u_ry.q -99 ps: leaf clk->y 411 ps then ~650 ps of wire, the u_ry capture flops were pulled toward rz[] / the W face (leaf y pins at its bottom-right corner, fr_rz on the W face ~670 um away) -> io_flop_at_pins.macro_out_pins [y, vo, fault] (OT_MPCAP_PINS) anchors them beside the leaf pins; (3) zh_err_q -> gqv[1] -59 ps (OR of 16 bits from 4 trees) -> gz[a] per tree, fault ORs gz on the same edge. 0 cycles, edge-exact (bench s4o m0 + mutants). Pin geometry unchanged (same pins / pin_ranges / macro places as a5). || KV-AHUB7 10-19 (COORD 17:00 review of a6 944df8a10: floorplan geometry ACCEPTED, the 0-cycle RTL tweak NOT; safe-design item 2: no single-cycle wire > 405 um): one REGISTERED relay stage on each > 405 um leg, pins / pin_ranges / macro places / outline identical to a6 (geometry_sha256 1d302540 unchanged): (1) tree selects: rt_q[a] = q_rs[a] & root_a, one 32-flop word beside each Z tree (each select flop drives only its tree's 32 ANDs), rc_x = OR of the four words one edge later, rc_v follows (rc_vp); (2) reciprocal y -> core rz[]: RY_RLY 2 (stage 0 anchored at the leaf y/vo/fault pins by OT_MPCAP_PINS, stage 1 free on the ~650 um leg); (3) W-face export: u_io export flops -> u_rw relay (WF_RLY 1, 145 b) -> fr pins; u_io emits WF_RLY edges earlier (tgt = PV_START + R + FR_OFS - WF_RLY) so fr lands on the same die edge and the die binding FR_OFS -7 / AHUB_OFS_BOUND is unchanged.  Also item 3: core reset region rn[1] (296 loads, gate textbook.high_fanout) split: zseen[2..3] on a 5th ot_rst_pipe region.  Bench s4o (5.050): m0 PASS, m1-m10 FAIL with a6's exact error counts, new m11 (tree-select relay bypassed) and m12 (W-face relay bypassed) FAIL.

reroute_reason.why: a3 (qkd_ahub_sdw-a3-dad8bea8e) is the RTL default (stride 16, AP_OFS {4{2}}, FR_OFS 0) = a reference only, not die-bindable; a4 (stride 4, default offsets) fails against the die (s4o m8). a5 = the die's binding (HKV-DIE3 OT_KV_AHUB_OFS, fa7fe4ff9 table). a6 also changes the RTL (rc_x one-hot root select, per-tree Z-error fault flops; 0 cycles, edge-exact) after a5 74c87116c routed NEEDS_RTL TT -357.42 on cross-cluster wire. a7 (KV-AHUB7, COORD 17:00): RTL adds one registered relay stage on each > 405 um leg (tree select, reciprocal y, W-face export; recip loop +2 edges, calendar HUB_PUB + 2) + core reset region split; geometry identical to the COORD-reviewed a6 kit.
